localeTag.description: BCP 47 tag of this translation (e.g. de, pt-BR, zh-TW), used for date, number and list formatting and the page's lang attribute. Set it to this catalog's own locale, not a translated word.

textDirection.description: Writing direction of this translation: ltr or rtl. Not a translated word.

extName.description: Extension name. Product name; normally left untranslated.

extDescription.message: Bookmark sync utility for Chrome and Firefox
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension list and store.

appLogoAlt.description: Alt text for the logo in the page header.

optionsTitle.description: Options page heading and tab title.

enableSyncing.description: Toggle that turns automatic syncing on or off.

enableNotifications.description: Toggle that turns desktop notifications for sync failures on or off.

lastSynced.description: Time of the last successful sync. $1 is a formatted date and time.

syncNow.description: Button that starts a sync immediately.

openSettings.description: Button in the popup that opens the options page.

version.description: Extension version. $1 is the version number, e.g. 0.5.2.

tabTools.description: Options page tab name for the bookmark cleanup tools.

settingsHeading.description: Heading of the general settings card.

syncStorageHeading.description: Heading of the card where the user picks where bookmarks are stored.

helpHeading.description: Heading of the help links card.

helpSetup.message: Get help on setup and use of XBookSync.
helpSetup.description: Link to the README / user guide.

helpIssues.message: For issues or feature requests in XBookSync.
helpIssues.description: Link to the GitHub issue tracker.

sortBookmarks.description: Toggle that turns automatic sorting on or off.

sortOrder.description: Label for the sort direction dropdown.

sortFolders.description: Label for the dropdown choosing how folders are sorted relative to bookmarks.

sortTogether.description: Folders and bookmarks are sorted in one list.

syncRate.description: Label for how often automatic syncs run.

durationDays.description: Column label in the sync interval picker.

durationHours.description: Column label in the sync interval picker.

durationMinutes.description: Column label in the sync interval picker.

durationSeconds.description: Column label in the sync interval picker.

durationDecrease.description: Accessible label for a minus button. $1 is a unit name such as Days or Minutes.

durationIncrease.description: Accessible label for a plus button. $1 is a unit name such as Days or Minutes.

durationSummary.description: Summary of the sync interval. $1 is a localized duration such as '15 minutes' or '1 hour and 30 minutes'. Use a phrasing that works for any unit (avoid gender/number agreement with $1).

storageType.description: Label for the storage target dropdown.

storageSelect.description: Placeholder option in the storage dropdown.

storageS3.description: Storage option: an Amazon S3 bucket.

noStorageSelected.description: Shown when no storage target is chosen.

notImplemented.message: This feature is not implemented yet
notImplemented.description: Shown for storage targets that are not available yet.

ghLogin.description: Button that starts signing in to GitHub.

ghRemoveToken.description: Button that signs out of GitHub locally.

ghEnterCode.description: Device login instructions. $1 is the one-time code (with a copy button), $2 is the GitHub URL to enter it at.

ghCopyCode.description: Button that copies the one-time login code.

ghNotInstalled.message: Connected, but the app isn't installed on any account yet — that's what grants access to your repos.
ghNotInstalled.description: Shown after login when the GitHub App still needs to be installed.

ghInstall.description: Button that opens the GitHub App install page.

ghInstalled.description: Button the user clicks after installing the GitHub App, to check again.

ghSelectRepo.description: Placeholder option in the repository dropdown.

ghConnected.description: Status after a successful GitHub connection.

ghCodeExpired.message: The device code expired before it was authorized.
ghCodeExpired.description: Login error: the one-time code timed out.

syncFailedTitle.description: Title of the sync failure notification.

errRemoteMissing.message: The remote bookmarks file was deleted.
errRemoteMissing.description: Sync error: the bookmarks file in the repository is gone.

errNotConfigured.message: No sync target is configured yet.
errNotConfigured.description: Sync error: no storage target set up.

errAuthRequired.message: GitHub connection needs attention — reconnect in settings.
errAuthRequired.description: Sync error: GitHub login expired or was revoked. Clicking it opens settings.

errConflict.description: Sync error: another device changed the file at the same time.

errServer.message: GitHub is having issues — will retry.
errServer.description: Sync error: GitHub returned a server error.

toolsSearchFor.description: Heading of the card that picks which cleanup scans to run.

toolsEmptyFolders.description: Scan toggle and result card heading.

toolsDuplicateBookmarks.description: Scan toggle and result card heading.

toolsRun.description: Button that runs the selected scans.

toolsMergeFolders.description: Result card heading for duplicate folders.

toolsMergeFolderSet.description: Action that merges a set of same-named folders. $1 is the folder name.
